implement_multiagentenv_subclass: implement a subclass of MultiAgentEnv that overrides step, get_obs, reset, and other abstract methods for a custom multi-agent environment
override_step_method: override the step method in a MultiAgentEnv subclass to return reward, terminated, and info given a list of agent actions
override_get_obs_methods: override get_obs and get_obs_agent in a MultiAgentEnv subclass to return observations for all agents or a specific agent_id
override_get_avail_actions: override get_avail_actions and get_avail_agent_actions in a MultiAgentEnv subclass to return available actions for each agent
use_get_env_info: call get_env_info on a MultiAgentEnv instance to retrieve state_shape, obs_shape, n_actions, n_agents, and episode_limit
